compatibilityResearch.reason: Source inspection followed public-specification research to resolve a narrow observable compatibility edge case.
compatibilityResearch.productionUse: No implementation text or control flow was copied; the project-owned regression test defines the independently authored behavior.

compatibilityResearch.question: Which Functional Syntax behaviors are normative grammar requirements and which OWLAPI behaviors are compatibility-only observations

compatibilityResearch.reason: Source inspection was limited to provenance and narrow compatibility research after the W3C grammar and project parser contracts were established; observable results were captured through the pinned Java harness.
